provenance.fitted_on: APTOS 2019 validation split (n=549, image-level split, seed 42)
provenance.t_refer: highest P(referable) threshold with validation sensitivity >= 0.90
provenance.t_entropy: smallest entropy cut-off where accepted validation cases reach sensitivity >= 0.95 with abstention <= 20%
provenance.t_ood: 99th percentile of Mahalanobis distance (PCA-64 of CNN features) on validation
provenance.lesion_suspicious: 97th percentile of lesion-candidate area/count among validation grade 0-1 images
provenance.temperatures: temperature scaling per grader, minimising validation NLL
provenance.never_used: IDRiD and DDR are not used for any fitting or threshold
provenance.laterality_disc_right: measured on DeepDRiD (n=1163 decided): disc on image right -> OD
